summary: axios's browser XHR adapter (`lib/adapters/xhr.js`, CommonJS). It returns a Promise that builds an `XMLHttpRequest` from the request config: strips `Content-Type` for FormData, adds HTTP Basic `Authorization`, combines `baseURL`/`url` and serializes `params`, sets `timeout`, `withCredentials`, `responseType`, XSRF header from the cookie when same-origin or credentialed, request headers and progress listeners; on load it parses response headers and settles the promise via `settle`, rejects with `createError` on abort (`ECONNABORTED`), network error or timeout (`ETIMEDOUT` when `transitional.clarifyTimeoutError`), and supports cancellation through `cancelToken` and `AbortSignal` (rejecting with a `Cancel('canceled')`).

exports.module.exports: xhrAdapter(config) — performs the request and returns a Promise of the axios response
